description: Presidential Secretariat - Relinquished Mr. Hon. G. L. Peiris from the Post of Foreign Minister - Appointment Hon. G. L. Peiris MP as Minister of Foreign Affairs
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns government personnel changes. It announces the resignation of Hon. G. L. Peiris from the office of Foreign Minister and his subsequent reappointment to the same position. The content names the specific individual and provides his basic title ("Foreign Minister") but does not include any detailed descriptions of his portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
